# Better Pass — Verification Attack

The Awtsmoos renews every claim before evidence can give it finite weight;
Awtsmoos.com must therefore attack the implementation from syntax, contracts, HTTP, browser, mobile, and deployment state.

## Phase A — Mechanical Truth

- Re-read the newly written Portal tests completely.
- Enforce line ceilings and tab indentation on all mission source/test files.
- Run Node syntax checks over CommonJS server modules and ES modules where the runtime supports check mode.
- Run import-resolution checks for the Portal client graph.

## Phase B — Contract Truth

- Execute every new Portal Node test.
- Execute relevant existing ApiFamilyCatalog and UI-runtime tests.
- Prove adapter equivalence against the current catalog.
- Prove invalid envelopes/actions/queries fail in bounded explicit ways.

## Phase C — Runtime Truth

- Probe local `/api/portal` routes through the real port-8080 server.
- Probe local `/apps/` module URLs, including CompactJS.
- Verify `foundation.js` and `GevurahDomContract.js` resolve with JavaScript MIME.
- Exercise `/portal/` in Chrome and capture console/network/DOM evidence.

## Phase D — UX Truth

- Audit `/apps/` and `/portal/` at 390, 768, 1440, and 1920 widths.
- Check horizontal overflow, tiny targets, native-style leakage, list markers, unlabeled dialogs, and code overflow.
- Treat every site-owned console exception or module/resource failure as a blocker.

## NEXT_ACTION

Execute the test readback and mechanical verification; every failure becomes source work before deployment.
